notes_for_editor: Single source: the NHLR detail page, whose only visit is dated 7/9/22. Two web searches and the MFC and Wikipedia pages read found nothing on its construction, builder or staffing. The NHLR Mississippi index also lists a separate Hinds Lookout Tower (US 1659, MS 24); check whether it is the same site before merging. The condition claim rests on the 2022 visit alone; the register page has no current status field. Access is unknown and the site is described as vacated and overgrown, so the record should not suggest a public visit.
